jobs.title: Infrastructure Product Manager
jobs.description:
Who we are

Atoms is building the machines that power the next era of progress.

Over the last decade, software has transformed the digital world. But the physical world, where food is made, minerals are mined, goods are moved, and industries are run, remains far less intelligent, far less efficient, and far more constrained. We’re changing that.

Atoms builds Physical AI— real-world robots for the industries that move civilization forward, starting with food, mining, and transport. Our systems are designed to understand, predict, and control the real world with precision, turning complex physical operations into something more reliable, more scalable, and more productive.

This work requires more than robotics. It requires deep integration across hardware, software, AI, operations, manufacturing, and real estate. We don’t just build machines in a lab. We deploy them into real environments, operate them, learn from them, and improve them until they work at scale.

We are roboticists, engineers, operators, and builders. We believe the next great technology companies will not only transform information, but the physical systems that shape everyday life.

If you want to work on hard problems with real-world impact, join us.

About the role

We are looking for an experienced Infrastructure Product Manager to lead strategy for our internal infrastructure teams. Our mission is to abstract the complexity of both public cloud providers (such as Azure) and on-prem deployments (Frontier AI Lab), enabling our developers to move faster, ship more reliably, and operate at a lower cost.

In this role, you will act as a force multiplier for our entire engineering organization, overseeing a complex ecosystem that supports everything from core compute primitives to in-house built distributed systems such as KEQ , Cloudless Blob , Splitter , LogProc , and others.

What You’ll Do

- Drive Product Strategy: Own the roadmap for our internal services and platforms, including Core Compute (Kubernetes), Networking (Service Mesh/Istio), extensive in-house storage primitives (Postgres, Redis/Valkey, Kafka, CRDB, etc.), DevEx/Observab/Costs platforms,, Data and ML platforms, Security Platform.

- Champion Developer Velocity: Reduce friction by building and maintaining best-in-class developer experiences, including monorepo build systems and automated release pipelines.

- Enforce Reliability: Define and implement reliability standards across our stack to ensure high uptime and system stability for groups operating on our infrastructure.

- Optimize for Efficiency: Build and manage tools for cost attribution and optimization to ensure our infrastructure scales efficiently with our business.

- Pioneer New Domains: Spearhead infrastructure initiatives for high-growth areas

- Collaborate at Scale: Work closely with engineering leadership to align product development with long-term technical architecture.

What We’re Looking For

- Technical Fluency: A strong preference for candidates with a background in engineering in the infrastructure space.

- Scale Experience: Demonstrated success in product management at well-known, large-scale tech companies or high-growth infrastructure-focused startups.

- Product Rigor: A background in translating technical requirements into high-impact features. Strong judgment in balancing roadmap ambitions with the operational health, stability, and maintainability of the platform.

- Data-driven decision-making: Comfort with metrics such as SLOs, adoption, and cost efficiency, and a track record of using them to drive prioritization.

- Bar Raiser Mentality: A desire to challenge the status quo, championing operational excellence, and pushing teams to innovate faster.

- Communication across altitudes: The ability to go deep with engineers on architecture while also articulating the business value of infrastructure investments to executive stakeholders.

Why join us

At Atoms, you’ll work on one of the defining challenges of our time—bringing automation into the physical world to drive real, lasting impact. We exist to uncover valuable unknown truths and turn them into progress, which means constantly pushing beyond what’s known and building what doesn’t yet exist. The work is ambitious and often challenging, but it’s grounded in a shared sense of purpose and a team committed to seeing it through together. Our work only matters if it serves others, and we know that meaningful progress depends on the trust of the people we serve and the strength of our team—so we invest in both, creating an environment where you can do your best work and grow.

What else you need to know

This role is based in our San Francisco   office. Atoms is a company driven by invention and continuous change - we are constantly reimagining our industries, building new products, and refining how we operate. We do our best work together. That’s why all of our office-based teams work onsite, five days a week.

The base salary range for this role is $224,000 - $284,000 per year.

Actual compensation will be determined on an individual basis and may vary depending on experience, skills, and qualifications.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package. You may also be eligible for equity awards and an annual performance-based bonus.

Benefits Summary (USA Full-Time Exempt Employees):

- Medical, dental, and vision insurance (multiple plans, incl. HSA options).

- Company-paid life and disability insurance (short- and long-term).

- Voluntary insurance: accident, critical illness, hospital indemnity.

- Optional supplemental life insurance for self, spouse, and children.

- Pet insurance discount.

- 401(k).

- Health Savings Account (HSA)

- Flexible Spending Accounts (Healthcare, Dependent Care, Commuter)

- Discretionary vacation days

- 8 paid holidays per year

- Paid sick time

- Paid Parental Leave

Atoms accepts applications on an ongoing basis.

We help operators simplify complexity, grow their business, and deliver great experiences to every guest – wherever they are.

Our platform empowers food businesses of all sizes, from local heroes to regional chains and global enterprises. With Otter, restaurants can focus on what they do best: serving delicious food to their customers. And as they thrive, we’re helping make better food more accessible, reliable, and affordable for everyone.

What you'll do

As Product Manager for Otter's Integrations & Ecosystem domain, you'll own the connectivity engine behind every third-party integration in the Otter ecosystem - A system that links Otter to dozens of partner platforms and keeps those links authenticated, alive, and reliable at scale. You will

- Define a healthy ecosystem: Set the metrics that actually matter - usage, attach rate, retention lift, connections health etc and build the reporting and instrumentation that tracks ecosystem health

- Own connectivity engine roadmap: Define and drive the technical roadmap for a single self-healing integration engine that sits behind one reliable interface for every third-party connection including credential creation and management, session persistence, health monitoring, automated recovery and beyond

- Keep connections alive:  Partner with engineering to design systems that survive partner-side auth changes, session expiry etc. before they cause failures using adaptive retry, rotation strategies etc that hold success rates high

- Auto-heal broken links: Own the detect-and-recover loop for when connections do break. Define what "broken" means per integration, instrument the signals that catch failures early, and build the flows that re-establish connections automatically

- Scale the partner surface:  Onboard new partner platforms - POS, delivery, payments, inventory, and beyond into the engine. Define the integration contract, the connection patterns each partner needs (OAuth/SSO, credential-based, webhook etc), and the certification bar every connection clears before going LIVE

- Drive cross-functional execution: Partner with Engineering, Security, Design, BD, and GTM to balance new partner coverage against the reliability, compliance, and legal posture of a system that manages credentials and maintains connections at scale

What we're looking for

- 8-10 years of product management experience, with direct ownership of a technical platform, developer product, or integrations/connectivity system

- Technical fluency in integration architecture - OAuth/SSO, credential management, session and token lifecycle, webhook design, and bidirectional data sync etc

- A track record of owning system reliability at scale including defining SLOs, instrumenting health, and driving mean-time-to-recovery down through automated healing rather than manual ops

- Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives across Product, Engineering, Security, Design, and BD

- Experience in restaurants, retail, or a comparably complex vertical is a meaningful advantage

About the role

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to own the fleet management and device software behind our autonomous operations. In this role, you will own these products across autonomous haulage and on-road autonomy, working out how a site monitors its machines, assigns them work, reports on production, and diagnoses a machine when something goes wrong.

What you’ll do

- Fleets: Own the roadmap for the web application used to run autonomous haulage operations, covering real-time monitoring of machines on site, site mapping and operating zones, route definition and assignment, machine commands, and production reporting. Define and deliver the on-road version of the fleet product, including the requirements specific to road operation and the decisions on what carries over from haulage, what is rebuilt, and what is new.

- Device Software: Own the per-machine interface used by engineers, technicians, and operations for status, health, diagnostics, connectivity, and logging. Define what a person working at an individual machine needs to see and do, and how that relates to the fleet-level product.

- Production Reporting: Own the reporting our products provide on customer operations, including productivity, cycle time, utilization, and the surfaces used by site leadership to identify bottlenecks.

- Multi-Site and Access: Own the product requirements associated with scale, including site and account structure, user roles and permissions, deployment configuration, and the operational surfaces our field teams depend on.

- Platform Architecture: Define what belongs in a shared platform across markets and surfaces, what is specialized per market, and where separate implementations are warranted.

- Data and Integrations: Define how operational and machine data moves between our products, engineering systems, and customer systems, including the interfaces and reporting our customers and field teams depend on.

- Requirements and Prioritization: Write product requirements, maintain the roadmap, and run delivery with engineering. Define success metrics per capability and report against them. Own intake and prioritization of requests from customers, field teams, and internal stakeholders.

- Field Research: Conduct primary research with site leaders, deployment operations, field engineers, and technicians, in their working environment, and translate findings into product decisions.

- Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner with engineering, autonomy, field engineering and deployment operations, customer success, safety, and training, and represent these products to customers.

What we’re looking for

- Bachelor's degree in a technical, design, or business field is required, with 7+ years in product management. Equivalent experience will be considered in place of the degree.

- Demonstrated end-to-end ownership of a software product in production, from requirements through release and measured adoption, including at least one product taken from initial definition to first customers.

- Deep experience with operational or fleet software used by people who do not work at a desk, in industries such as mining, construction, energy, logistics, transportation, manufacturing, or field service.

- Experience with products that monitor or command physical equipment, vehicles, or machinery.

- Experience with real-time status and telemetry, mapping or geospatial interfaces, or dispatch and assignment workflows.

- Experience with multi-tenant products involving customer accounts, user roles, and permissions.

- Sufficient technical depth to work directly with engineers on distributed systems, connectivity, data pipelines, and system integrations, and to hold a position on architectural trade-offs.

- Demonstrated ability to establish and hold a product or technical direction across teams outside your reporting line.

- Primary user research experience conducted in the field, in the working environment of the user, rather than through surveys or proxies.

- Data fluency sufficient to query product usage and operational data directly, in SQL or an equivalent.

- Strong written communication across product requirements, decision records, and customer-facing material.

- Experience delivering in environments where the product, the underlying autonomy system, and the customer's operation are concurrently in development.

- Human Factors and Validation: Define how these experiences are validated with real operators, including comprehension, response time, and error rate under working conditions, and produce the evidence required for internal safety review.

- Training and Adoption: Partner with training and field operations on how operators learn the system, and use what surfaces there to reduce the amount of training the product requires.

- Requirements and Prioritization: Write product requirements, maintain the roadmap, and run delivery with engineering. Define success metrics per capability and report against them. Own intake and prioritization of requests from customers, field teams, and internal stakeholders.

- Field Research: Conduct primary research with equipment operators, vehicle operators, and supervisors, on site, and translate findings into product decisions.

- Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner with engineering, autonomy, safety, hardware, field engineering and deployment operations, and training, and represent these products to customers.

- Demonstrated end-to-end ownership of a human-facing product in production, from requirements through release and measured adoption.

- Experience owning human-machine interface products, in automotive, aviation, heavy equipment, industrial controls, medical devices, or a comparable domain.

- Experience designing for constrained operating conditions such as heavy vibration, glare, limited connectivity, etc.

- Demonstrated human factors practice, including usability testing with the actual user population and measurement of comprehension and response rather than preference.

- Experience working directly with industrial design, hardware engineering, and safety engineering on products with both physical and digital surfaces.

- Demonstrated ability to establish and hold a product or design direction across teams outside your reporting line.
